# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VOLUME_IMBALANCE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A strong downside volume bias within the first 15‑minute opening range predicts a short‑biased break below the OR low. When down‑bar volume exceeds 60% of total OR volume and price breaks below the OR low on elevated volume, the subsequent move tends to continue lower, offering a short edge.

## Mechanism

Define OR high/low from 9:30‑9:45 ET using 5‑min bars (or 1‑min aggregated). Compute down‑bar volume (sum of volume where close<open) and up‑bar volume (close>open) inside the OR. If down‑bar volume / total volume > 0.6 AND price breaks below OR low on a bar with volume > 1.5× the average 15‑min volume (average of the three 5‑min bars that form the OR), then go short at the close of that breakout bar. Exit: chart‑stop at OR high (structure invalidation), TP1 at 1R (initial risk), then trail the runner 15% off the high‑water mark. Only consider entries after 9:45 ET and when VIX > 18 to avoid opening‑gap noise and ensure sufficient intraday volatility.
